notes.title: Warrior Architects will introduce a multiplayer mode in the full release
notes.notes:
Warrior Architects will appear in the Spring Sale from March 13 to March 20!
This time, the game has received a major update, introducing the full multiplayer battle mode. In this mode, you can connect with nearby players for battles and create your own room, with up to 16 players per match.

The map features two tribes, one blue and one red. Players in the same tribe can work together to gather resources, construct buildings, train armies, and fight battles. The goal is to strengthen your tribe into a powerful empire and ensure its lasting prosperity.

Game Features
Story Mode: Embark on an adventure through 30 main storyline chapters, facing unique enemies and bosses.
Random Campaign Mode: Explore randomly generated battlefields, offering varied difficulties and endless strategic possibilities.
Creative Building Design: Plan and upgrade unique buildings to strengthen your power.
Real-Time Multiplayer Battles: Connect with nearby players to compete and expand your empire together.

Event Time
Pacific Time (PT): March 13, 2025 – March 20, 2025

You can try the demo version, and if you want to experience the multiplayer mode, the test version includes access to multiplayer mode testing!

notes.title: Warrior Architect Announces Official Release - Version 1.0 to Launch on October
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119731/8a820f098e178226871acd2796de8abfd3dad2b1.png[/img]
  Warrior Architect is a medieval fantasy game featuring a mix of story-driven campaigns, free battles, and survival modes. The Free Battle and Survival modes come with three difficulty levels, allowing players to build their empire across different stages according to their preferences.

  In campaigns, players earn equipment, items, and experience points by defeating enemies or completing missions, which allows them to level up and strengthen their units. Upon meeting certain level or resource requirements, players can research and unlock various technologies, such as buildings and new units.

  In a beautiful land once home to many peaceful tribes who thrived through mutual exchange, an evil, powerful empire arrived and scattered them, forcing many to flee. Some tribes fell under the empire's rule, enduring hardship before eventually escaping to remote frontiers. Here, they preserved their knowledge and thrived. Generations later, their descendants discovered an ancient sword and scroll documenting their ancestors’ lives and culture, igniting a quest to uncover their origins with a team of warriors who took up the sword and scroll.

Key Features of the Official Release

30 story-driven levels
28 unique unit classes
3 types of ships and 6 types of siege weapons
110 equipment items
55 skills
16 kinds of animals and monsters
